Никола Топић | image = | image_size = | caption = | position = [[Point guard]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 6 | weight_lb = 200 | league = [[NBA]] | team = Oklahoma City Thunder | number = 44 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2005|8|10|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Novi Sad]], [[Serbia and Montenegro]] | draft_year = 2024 | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 12 | draft_team = [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] | career_start = 2022 | years1 = 2022–2024 | team1 = [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] | years2 = 2022 | team2 = →[[KK Slodes|Slodes]] | years3 = 2023 | team3 = →[[OKK Beograd]] | years4 = 2023 | team4 = →[[KK Mega Basket|Mega]] | years5 = {{nbay|2024|start}}–present | team5 = [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] | years6 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]] | team6 = →[[Oklahoma City Blue]] | highlights = * [[List of NBA champions|NBA champion]] ([[2025 NBA Finals|2025]]) * 2× [[ABA League]] champion ([[2021–22 ABA League First Division|2022]], [[2023–24 ABA League First Division|2024]]) * [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]] champion (2024) * [[Radivoj Korać Cup|Serbian Cup]] winner (2024) * [[ABA League Top Prospect]] ([[2023–24 ABA League First Division|2024]]) * [[ABA League Ideal Starting Five|All-ABA League Team]] ([[2023–24 ABA League First Division|2024]]) * [[FIBA U18 European Championship]] MVP ([[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship|2023]]) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{Flagu|Serbia}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA U18 European Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship|2023 Serbia]]|[[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Nikola Topić''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Никола Топић}}, {{ipa|sr|nikola topitɕ}}, born 10 August 2005) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=6}}, he plays at the [[point guard]] position. He missed his rookie season due to an [[ACL tear]] and the bulk of his sophomore season due to a battle with [[testicular cancer]]. ==Early career== Topić grew up playing basketball for KK Defense from his native [[Novi Sad]] from which he joined the [[KK Crvena zvezda (youth)|Crvena zvezda youth system]] in June 2020.{{cite web |title=Nikola Topić profile |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/player/nikola-topic/ |website=kkcrvenazvezda.rs |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Novi potpis u Zvezdi – ugovor za sina legende kluba |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2020&mm=06&dd=08&nav_id=1692758 |website=b92.net |access-date=29 March 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Crvena zvezda (2022–2024)=== On 28 March 2022, Topić made his professional debut for [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] in an [[ABA League]] match against Slovenian side [[KK Krka|Krka]] at the age of 16. He scored 4 points and had 5 assists over 16 minutes of playing time. At 16 years, seven months and eighteen days of age, he became the youngest player in club history to score points for Crvena zvezda in the ABA League.{{cite web |title= Crvena zvezda mts youngster Nikola Topić sets new club record as the reigning champions beat Krka |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/46741/crvena-zvezda-mts-youngster-nikola-topic-sets-new-club-record-as-the-reigning-champions-beat-krka/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Mladići borovi: Mali Top zakoračio na crveno-beli put Slavnića, Stojakovića, Radmanovića, Kapičića... |url=https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/mladici-borovi-mali-top-zakoracio-na-crveno-beli-put-slavnica-stojakovica-radmanovica-kapicica/416088 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Youngster Nikola Topic enters Zvezda's history books in win over Krka |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/aba/1325900/youngster-nikola-topic-enters-zvezdas-history-books-in-win-over-krka/ |website=eurohoops.net |date=28 March 2022 |access-date=2 April 2022}} On 1 April 2022, Topić made his EuroLeague debut in an 82–57 loss to [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]],{{cite web |date=2 April 2022 |title=FC Bayern Munich 82 57 FINAL Crvena Zvezda mts Belgrade logo Crvena Zvezda mts Belgrade |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/game-center/2021-22/fc-bayern-munich-crvena-zvezda-mts-belgrade/E2021/293/#boxscore |access-date=2 April 2022 |website=euroleaguebasketball.net}} becoming one of the [[List of youngest EuroLeague players since the 2000–01 season|youngest players to ever play in the EuroLeague]] at 16 years and 253 days of age. ====2022–23 season==== At the start of the 2022–23 season, Topić was loaned to the Serbian team [[KK Slodes|Slodes]] in September 2022.{{cite news |title=Nikola Topić i Lazar Trifković na pozajmici u Slodesu |url=https://sportal.blic.rs/kosarka/domaca-kosarka-i-aba/nikola-topic-i-lazar-trifkovic-na-pozajmici-u-slodesu/2022090313162267880 |access-date=3 January 2024 |work=blic.rs |date=3 September 2022 |language=sr}} He returned to Crvena zvezda shortly after, and played with the team from October until December of the same year, during which in limited role he averaged 3.4 points over seven [[ABA League]] games. On 9 January 2023, the ABA League declined and cancelled Topić's transfer to [[KK FMP|FMP Meridian]].{{cite web |title=Veliki problemi za Zvezdinog pleja: Nikola Topić ne može da igra za FMP |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/veliki-problemi-za-zvezdinog-pleja-nikola-topic-ne-moze-da-igra-za-fmp/440325 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=10 January 2023}}{{cite web |title=Ništa od transfera, ABA zabranila registraciju Nikole Topića za FMP |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2023&mm=01&dd=09&nav_id=2271039 |website=b92.net |access-date=10 January 2023}} Eventually, he was loaned to [[OKK Beograd]] for the rest of the 2022–23 season.{{cite web |title=Nikola Topić u OKK Beogradu |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/nikola-topic-u-okk-beogradu/440362 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=10 January 2023}} With OKK Beograd, he appeared in 19 games of the [[2022–23 Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]], averaging 17.8 points on 55.2% shooting from the field, 5.3 assists and 3.8 rebounds per game. ====2023–24 season==== On 17 July 2023, Topić signed his first professional contract with Crvena zvezda.{{cite news |title=NIKOLA TOPIĆ POTPISAO PRVI UGOVOR I POSTAO PRVOTIMAC CRVENE ZVEZDE! |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/2023/07/17/nikola-topic-potpisao-prvi-ugovor-i-postao-prvotimac-crvene-zvezde/ |access-date=5 January 2024 |work=kkcrvenazvezda.rs |date=17 July 2023 |language=sr}} At the start of the 2023–24 season, Topić was loaned to Serbian team [[KK Mega Basket|Mega]]. He averaged 18.6 points, 6.9 assists and 3.7 rebounds over 13 games, before being loaned back to Crvena zvezda in December 2023.{{cite news |title=NIKOLA TOPIĆ SE VRATIO SVOJOJ KUĆI U CRVENU ZVEZDU! |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/2023/12/26/nikola-topic-se-vratio-svojoj-kuci-u-crvenu-zvezdu/ |access-date=3 January 2024 |date=26 December 2023 |language=sr}} On 4 January 2024, he suffered a knee injury in a game against [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]].{{cite news |title=NIKOLA SE POVREDIO NA DERBIJU, MORAO U SVLAČIONICU! Ova fotografija će zabrinuti crveno-bele, BOLI GA! |url=https://mondo.rs/Sport/Kosarka/a1873107/Nikola-Topic-se-povredio-na-Zvezda-Partizan-u-Evroligi.html |access-date=3 March 2024 |work=mondo.rs |date=4 January 2024}} On 10 April 2024, he won the [[ABA League Top Prospect]] award after securing more than half of the votes. He averaged 17.9 points, 6.8 assists and 3.6 rebounds when he won the award.{{Cite web |title=Nikola Topic named 2023-24 ABA League Top Prospect |url=https://basketnews.com/news-204472-nikola-topic-named-2023-24-aba-league-top-prospect.html |access-date=2024-04-11 |website=basketnews.com |language=en}} On 13 May 2024, Topić suffered a partially [[torn ACL]] in a game against Partizan Belgrade.{{cite web|first=Johnny|last=Askounis|date=13 May 2024 |title=Nikola Topic suffers a knee injury in ABA Finals|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/aba/1671367/nikola-topic-suffers-knee-injury-crvena-zvezda-nba/|access-date=24 December 2025 |website=Eurohoops.net}}{{Cite web |last=Givony |first=Johnathan |date=2024-06-05 |title=ACL tear for potential top-10 NBA draft pick Topic |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40284258 |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ===Oklahoma City Thunder (2024–present)=== On 26 June 2024, Topić was selected with the twelfth overall pick by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{cite web|first=Joshua|last=Valdez|title=Thunder headline 2024 NBA Draft biggest 1st-round winners|url=https://clutchpoints.com/oklahoma-city-thunder-headline-2024-nba-draft-biggest-1st-round-winners|website=ClutchPoints|date=26 June 2024|access-date=26 June 2024}} On 6 July, he signed with the Thunder.{{cite web|title=Thunder Signs Nikola Topić and Dillon Jones|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/topic-jones-mitchell-240706|website=NBA.com|date=6 July 2024|access-date=14 July 2024}} It was later announced that Topić was expected to miss the entirety of the [[2024–25 NBA season|2024–25 season]] due to surgery on his torn ACL.{{Cite web |last=Almanza |first=Clemente |date=2024-07-24 |title=Thunder's Nikola Topic undergoes surgery for torn ACL |url=https://okcthunderwire.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/thunder/2024/07/24/thunders-nikola-topic-undergoes-surgery-for-torn-acl/74529366007/ |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=OKC Thunder Wire |language=en-US}} Topić won his first [[NBA championship]] in 2025 despite not playing in a single game, becoming the third-youngest NBA player to win a title.{{cite web |date=2025-06-23 |title=Nikola Topic makes NBA history following Thunder's championship win |url=https://basketnews.com/news-226630-nikola-topic-makes-nba-history-following-thunders-championship-win.html |access-date=2025-06-23 |website=basketnews.com}} On 6 October 2025, it was announced that Topić would miss at least four to six weeks after undergoing a testicular procedure.{{Cite web |date=2025-10-06 |title=Thunder PG Nikola Topic out 4-6 weeks after porcedure |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/46512558 |access-date=2025-10-11 |website=espn.com |language=en}} On 30 October, Thunder general manager [[Sam Presti]] told reporters that the procedure Topić received at [[MD Anderson Cancer Center]] in Houston was a biopsy that confirmed a testicular cancer diagnosis, and that after receiving the results, Topić asked the Thunder to not publicly reveal his diagnosis until he had started chemotherapy treatments. Topić has been able to work out while beginning chemotherapy, but Presti said there is no timetable for him to make his NBA debut.{{Cite web |last=MacMahon |first=Tim |date=2025-10-30 |title=Thunder's Nikola Topic being treated for testicular cancer |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/46782473 |access-date=2025-10-30 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} On 9 February 2026, Topić made his [[NBA G League]] debut with the [[Oklahoma City Blue]] while on assignment from the Thunder, his first game action since his diagnosis. On 12 February, he made his NBA debut with the Thunder in a home game against the [[2025–26 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee Bucks]].{{Cite web |date=2026-02-13 |title=Nikola Topic makes Thunder debut after testicular cancer |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/47914037 |access-date=2026-02-13 |website=ESPN.com}} ==National team career== In August 2021, Topić was a member of the [[Serbia men's national under-16 basketball team|Serbian under-16 national team]] that participated at the [[2021 FIBA U16 European Challengers|FIBA U16 European Challengers]] in Novi Sad, Serbia. He played only one game, recording 17 points, 8 rebounds and 5 assists in an 83–52 win over the [[Czech Republic men's national under-16 and under-17 basketball team|Czech Republic]]. He represented the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbian national team]] in his debut on 16 August 2023 where Serbia played a friendly match against Puerto Rico.{{cite web |title=2021 U16 Serbia #14 - Nikola TOPIĆ Point Guard |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/challengers/u16/2021/player/Nikola-Topi%C4%87 |website=fiba.basketball |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web|title=Groups B & C - Group C - CZE SRB 52-83|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/challengers/u16/2021/game/1608/Czech-Republic-Serbia|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=29 March 2022}} ==Career statistics== |url=https://meridianbetsport.rs/kosarka/nikola-topic-zvezda-milenko-topic/ |website=meridianbetsport.rs |date=28 March 2022 |access-date=30 March 2022}} A [[power forward]], Milenko spent most of his career in the [[YUBA League]] playing for [[KK Profikolor|Profikolor]], [[KK BFC Beočin|BFC Beočin]] and Crvena zvezda, as well as [[KK Budućnost|Budućnost]] and [[KK Vršac|Hemofarm]]. In later career, Milenko played in Italy and Greece. Milenko also represented the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Yugoslavian national team]] internationally (representing [[FR Yugoslavia]]), with whom he won gold medals at the [[EuroBasket 1997]] and the [[1998 FIBA World Championship]], a silver medal at the [[Basketball at the 1996 Summer Olympics|1996 Summer Olympics]], and a bronze at the [[EuroBasket 1999]].{{cite web
